tickets.text: RETRACEMENT forming (C2/C7 shape): W and D HH/HL, D 3.7% under the last swing high, H1 below EMA9. First pullback after fresh highs; I buy it at the 20-day (reclaim:ma_20 on H1), not at the breakout.
The wrong-if's '8% below fill' is a percentage line; my stop is structural, one or two ticks beyond the swing extreme (C17). Read bar_low as where the test of the break failed.
Horizon 20 sessions is long for a test-of-the-break entry; minimise time in the market (C18) and manage it in bars, protecting any windfall (C19).
